what: Place errors on a by-value self parameter: hir span_syntax maps Span::BindingId(self) through patterns_for_binding, which is empty for self, so e.g. E0277 Self: Sized on `fn head(self)` in a trait is unplaced (reported at the item). rustc places it at `self`. Add a SelfParam case to hir SpanAst (source map self_param syntax) so these are placed; then move the test an_unplaced_type_error_names_its_type_trait_and_item to another unplaced case and add a placed self test.
